name: per_token_quant_int8
description: Per-row symmetric int8 quantization. x is [M,N]; for each row amax=max(abs(x)).clamp_min(1e-10), scale=amax/127, q=clamp(x/scale,-128,127).to(int8). Returns q int8 [M,N] and scales float32 [M,1]. This is the group-quantization case with group_size=N. Current tests exercise bfloat16 inputs with N 128..8192; no input mutation.
